description: This file defines a set of classes and schemas for interacting with Jira's API, including issue management, comments, and user operations. It also provides a factory function to create configured Jira tools based on specified actions.

classes.name: BaseJiraTool
classes.description: A base class extending DynamicStructuredTool, providing common Jira API request functionality and handling authentication.

classes.name: ListIssuesTool
classes.description: Tool for listing Jira issues based on JQL queries.

classes.name: CreateIssueTool
classes.description: Tool for creating new Jira issues.

classes.name: GetIssueTool
classes.description: Tool for retrieving details of a specific Jira issue.

classes.name: UpdateIssueTool
classes.description: Tool for updating existing Jira issues.

classes.name: AssignIssueTool
classes.description: Tool for assigning Jira issues to users.

classes.name: TransitionIssueTool
classes.description: Tool for transitioning Jira issues between statuses.

classes.name: ListCommentsTool
classes.description: Tool for listing comments on Jira issues.

classes.name: CreateCommentTool
classes.description: Tool for adding comments to Jira issues.

classes.name: GetCommentTool
classes.description: Tool for retrieving a specific comment from a Jira issue.

classes.name: UpdateCommentTool
classes.description: Tool for updating comments on Jira issues.

classes.name: DeleteCommentTool
classes.description: Tool for deleting comments from Jira issues.

classes.name: SearchUsersTool
classes.description: Tool for searching users in Jira.

classes.name: GetUserTool
classes.description: Tool for retrieving user details from Jira.

classes.name: CreateUserTool
classes.description: Tool for creating new Jira users.

classes.name: UpdateUserTool
classes.description: Tool for updating existing Jira users.

methods.name: makeJiraRequest
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request to Jira API with proper authentication and error handling.

methods.name: createJiraTools
methods.description: Factory function that creates and returns a list of Jira tools based on specified actions and configuration.
